entities.summary: Juan Ramón Aguirre Lanari was an Argentine lawyer, diplomat, politician, and professor of constitutional law, who served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1982 until 1983. Aguirre Lanari was the last Foreign Minister of the National Reorganization Process before the end of Argentina's military dictatorship in 1983. While not a member of the military, Aguirre Lanari saw his 1982 appointment to the Foreign Ministry as a way to guide the dictatorship towards a transition to democracy. He accepted his assignment as Foreign Minister following assurances by President Reynaldo Bignone that new elections would be held by early 1984.
